# The Fictorians

> A collaborative fiction writing collective dedicated to craft, community, and authentic storytelling across multiple genres.

The Fictorians is a community of published authors who share writing expertise through blog posts, member profiles, and craft guides. The site covers fiction writing techniques, author experiences, mental health topics, and curated industry resources.

## Key Topics

- Fiction Writing
- Writing Craft
- Character Development
- Author Collective
- Writing Community
- PTSD and Trauma Recovery
- Personal Essays
- Writing Productivity
- Indie Publishing
- Author Marketing
- Mental Health
- Special Needs Parenting
- Coping Strategies
- Story Structure
- Member Directory

## About & Community

- [The Fictorians](https://www.fictorians.com): Homepage for The Fictorians fiction writing collective.
- [The Fictorians – Member Directory](https://www.fictorians.com/the-fictorians): Member directory featuring Ace Jordyn, Brandon M. Lindsay, and other authors.

## Writing Craft & Technique

- [Real Characters](https://www.fictorians.com/2019/04/02/real-characters): Writing craft article on character development and narrative authenticity.
- [I must increase](https://www.fictorians.com/2019/04/09/i-must-increase): Author journal on writing productivity and word count sprint goals.
- [Writing Craft Guide](https://www.fictorians.com/page/436): Writing craft guide covering revision, plot development, and story structure.

## Author Perspectives & Essays

- [PTSD: Not Just for Veterans](https://www.fictorians.com/2020/01/07/ptsd-not-just-for-veterans): Personal essay on PTSD trauma recovery and coping strategies.

## Blog & Community Updates

- [Blog – Page 2](https://www.fictorians.com/page/2): Blog posts on author marketing and social media strategy.
- [Blog – Page 3](https://www.fictorians.com/page/3): Blog content on author collaboration and indie publishing strategies.
- [The Times, They Are A'Changin'](https://www.fictorians.com/2018/06/10/the-times-they-are-achangin): Editorial announcement regarding blog hiatus and publication schedule changes.

## Resources & References

- [Links of Interest](https://www.fictorians.com/links-of-interest): Curated writing resources including Evil Editor, Magical Words, and agents.
